issues.detail: The Hebrew has 'עַד אֶגְלַיִם' (until Eglaim) and 'וּבְאֵר אֵילִים' (and Beer-elim), but the Chinese renders '以革倫' (Ekron) for Eglaim and '以琳井' (Elim well) for Beer-elim. Eglaim is a place name distinct from Ekron (עֶקְרוֹן), and Beer-elim is a specific location, not the same as Elim (אֵילִם). This swaps/drops the proper names, changing the geography.
